name: University of Duisburg-Essen
description: The University of Duisburg-Essen is a public university in the Ruhr area of North Rhine-Westphalia, formed in 2003 from the universities of Duisburg and Essen. It has more than 37,000 students on its two campuses and a university hospital in Essen.
whyIncluded: The University of Duisburg-Essen is among the 10 universities in Germany most chosen by international students (about 7,800 international students, 21% of more than 37,000, per an aggregator figure), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Angewandte Informatik - Schwerpunkte Ingenieur- oder Medieninformatik B.Sc.
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket. Taught in German.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: North Rhine-Westphalia's public universities charge none, including for non-EU students, and UDE's fee page lists only the social and student-body contribution. Compulsory fees = Sozial- und Studierendenschaftsbeitrag for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 367.80 x2: mobility contribution (Deutschlandsemesterticket) 226.80 + social contribution (Studierendenwerk) 125.00 + student body 16.00. History (same page): winter 2024/25 EUR 302.40 (ticket 176.40 + 110.00 + 16.00) -> 604.80; winter 2025/26 EUR 349.80 (208.80 + 125.00 + 16.00) -> 699.60. Language of instruction: German. Duisburg campus. Applied computer science (engineering or media informatics). 6 semesters, 180 ECTS (programme page studiengang.php?id=1). Programme name and language from UDE's bachelor's overview (uni-due.de/de/studium/bachelor.php).
